english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being ill or in poor health.
Use this as the straightforward everyday choice for being sick or medically unwell.
Use this when a person or animal is actually sick or ill, rather than merely exposed to unhealthy conditions.
Use 病 when someone is ill, including being down with an illness such as flu.

examples.english: I'm sick today, so I'm not going to work.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 beng6 zo2 m4 faan1 gung1 laa3

examples.english: The dog is unhealthy and needs to see a vet.
examples.traditional: 隻狗病咗，要帶佢睇獸醫。
examples.jyutping: zek3 gau2 beng6 zo2 jiu3 daai3 keoi5 tai2 sau3 ji1

examples.english: I was down with an illness yesterday and didn't go to work.
examples.traditional: 我噚日開始病，今日冇返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hoi1 ci2 beng6 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1
